ExtraDock 4.2.4 – Space Awareness 2.0 & License Clarity! 🪐🔑

✨ What's New

  • Space Awareness 2.0: Completely reworked Space Awareness widget (beta v2) — now requires Accessibility permissions for a much smarter, more reliable experience!
  • License Renewal Info: Remaining license time is now shown on the main screen and menu bar, with a dismissible renewal nudge so you're always in the know!
  • Support Email Diagnostics: Copy a dock's debug info or attach it directly from the Support button — getting help has never been easier!

⚡ Improvements

  • Full Timezone Picker: The Clock widget now includes every IANA timezone, grouped by region with GMT offsets — find any timezone instantly!
  • Folder Stack Name Wrapping: Folder Stack now wraps long names so nothing gets cut off!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Folder Stack Arrow Fix: The arrow on Folder Stack now displays correctly on side and top docks!

🗑️ Removed

  • Running-Indicator Dots: Replaced by the new minimized overlay — cleaner and more informative!
  • "Hide from This Widget" Menu Item: Pin to your dock instead for a simpler, more intuitive workflow!

🚀 What's Next?

We're continuing to refine and expand ExtraDock with new widgets, smarter behaviors, and more customization options. Keep sharing your feedback — you're shaping the future of ExtraDock!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
